'''A-B6''', or '''Ay-BeeSix''', was the fourth member of the [[Farns]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], along with [[Geordi Hans]], [[Jeff Pill]], and [[Franklin Scott]]. She often asked questions and got in the way, but the gang put up with her. Once Franklin asked her to go into [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] and get a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]], which led to an altercation with a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] which damaged her. Since being repaired the gang has treated her with more care.<ref name="GG7" />
